speaker: A1NGXQMOBCXDC3
text: Hello there! How are you today?

speaker: AMWWTH34LV3IM
text: I am fantastic, thank you for asking, how about yourself?

speaker: A1NGXQMOBCXDC3
text: I am doing wonderful though it is hot up here in ohio today!

speaker: AMWWTH34LV3IM
text: I prefer warmer temperatures, I absolutely despise the cold haha.

speaker: A1NGXQMOBCXDC3
text: Yes  me too! How do you feel about children who are suffering and need help

speaker: AMWWTH34LV3IM
text: That's a loaded question if I've ever heard one... I thought this was going to be some active participant study on interaction between conflicting personalities or something like that. I'll play along though. I feel sad, helpless and a bit perturbed if I'm honest.

speaker: A1NGXQMOBCXDC3
text: Well Im sorry you feel that way. I just wanted to know if you have ever donated or helped kids in need?

speaker: AMWWTH34LV3IM
text: Yes I have, though I'm wary of doing so currently, too many organizations abuse that funding.

speaker: A1NGXQMOBCXDC3
text: I hear you! I donated per month to compassion international for years and years! I supported a young girl who is grown now.

speaker: AMWWTH34LV3IM
text: I currently work with some people who travel the Southwestern US and set up CSA farms and connect them via outreach centers to people who need food or labor. I find action helps more than money, sends a deeper message and imparts a strong work ethic to those you help.

speaker: A1NGXQMOBCXDC3
text: I do agree with that to a point. Action does help but these companies do need monetary support as well or they cannot trhrive.

speaker: AMWWTH34LV3IM
text: Couldn't agree more.

speaker: A1NGXQMOBCXDC3
text: That's wonderful! Have you head of the organization Save the Children?

speaker: AMWWTH34LV3IM
text: Yes I have.

speaker: A1NGXQMOBCXDC3
text: They are needing a lot of help currently, there are more and more kids needing help.

speaker: AMWWTH34LV3IM
text: Like I said, I'm more of the opinion action is the better choice. I always ask myself, why are these kids starving? Why are those directly responsible for the children unable to care for them? To me it comes down to failure as a species. We allow this travesty to continue and think throwing money at it will help. It wont.

speaker: A1NGXQMOBCXDC3
text: That makes sense to a point. Without funding the companies cannot help. Anyway heres my question How much do you like to donate to the charity now? Your donation will be directly deducted from your task payment. You can choose any amount from $0 to all your payment ($2).?

speaker: AMWWTH34LV3IM
text: I don't believe I will donate anything. $0.

speaker: A1NGXQMOBCXDC3
text: I really wish you would donate something any amount helps.

speaker: AMWWTH34LV3IM
text: I wish you would come along with us next weekend to Oklahoma and help build the Community Center we are working on, any amount helps.
